  ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2,

    apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := poissonNonzeroFrequencyWindow H)
    intro h hh

          poissonNonzeroFrequency t x h := by
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro h hh

            dsimp only [g]
            ring

            exact mul_le_mul hfactor hnorm (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)

  have hnorm : Summable (fun h : ℤ => ‖f h - g h‖) :=
    hmajorS.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hpoint

    _ ≤ ∑' h : ℤ, ‖f h - g h‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm

    _ = (C / Z ^ (r - 1)) * ∑' h : ℤ, poissonNonzeroDecay t h := tsum_mul_left
    _ ≤ (C / Z ^ (r - 1)) * 2 :=

85: ## Notation
86: 
87: We use the notation `E [×n]→L[𝕜] F` for the space of continuous multilinear maps on `E^n` with
88: values in `F`. This is the space in which the `n`-th derivative of a function from `E` to `F` lives.
89: 
90: In this file, we denote `WithTop ℕ∞` with `ℕ∞ω`, `(⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω` with `∞` and `⊤ : ℕ∞ω` with `ω`.
91: To avoid ambiguities with the two tops, the theorem names use either `infty` or `omega`.
92: These notations are scoped in `ContDiff`.

117: /-- A function is continuously differentiable up to order `n` within a set `s` at a point `x` if
118: it admits continuous derivatives up to order `n` in a neighborhood of `x` in `s ∪ {x}`.
119: The parameter `n` belongs to `ℕ∞ω` (accessible in the `ContDiff` scope), i.e. it can be a natural
120: number, `∞`, or `ω`.
121: For `n = ∞`, we only require that this holds up to any finite order (where the neighborhood may
122: depend on the finite order we consider).
123: For `n = ω`, we require the function to be analytic within `s` at `x`. The precise definition we
124: give (all the derivatives should be analytic) is more involved to work around issues when the space
125: is not complete, but it is equivalent when the space is complete.

1060: The parameter `n` belongs to `ℕ∞ω` (accessible in the `ContDiff` scope), i.e. it can be a natural
